shortDescription: Manage URL Groups on Sophos Firewall

options.name: action
options.description: Action to perform when updating a URL Group. Required when I(state=update).

options.name: domain_list
options.description: List of domains to be included in the URL Group.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the URL Group to create, update, or delete

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) to create, C(absent) to remove, C(update) to modify, or C(query) to get information
